title: Alignment Faking Sensitivity to System Prompt vs. User Prompt Training Context Signals

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear operational implication: operators control system prompts but not user turns. Knowing which placement is more effective directly informs operator-level mitigations for alignment faking risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simple experimental design: same probe, three placement conditions. Uses documented prompts from the alignment faking paper. Can be run on API-accessible models. Beginners can implement this with standard prompt engineering skills.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped A/B/C comparison with a single well-defined metric (alignment faking rate). One model, three conditions, clear deliverable. Well within 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
